Screen / context: Maia-specific sampling guidance for the 2.5 default proposal. Preserve probability mass versus individual move probability, the five-full-move boundary and conditional direct-match strength claims. Not a Lichess equivalent. Explanation selector changes prose only.
English source:
On by default. Uses Temperature and Top-P 1.0 / 1.0 for the first five moves by each side, then your configured settings from move 6. This keeps broad opening choices while allowing you to trim low-probability moves later. It follows the position’s move number, including when resuming or continuing a game.

Not needed at 1.0 / 1.0: the switch is off and unavailable because those settings already give full variety throughout.
Japanese (provisional):
初期設定ではオンです。双方の最初の5手には温度とTop-P 1.0 / 1.0を使い、6手目から設定した値を使います。序盤の幅広い選択肢を保ちつつ、その後は確率の低い手を絞れます。再開や途中局面からの対局でも、その局面の手数に従います。

1.0 / 1.0では最初から最後まで幅広い候補を使うため、このスイッチは不要となり、オフの状態で選択できなくなります。
Simplified Chinese (provisional):
默认开启。双方前五步使用温度和Top-P 1.0 / 1.0，从第六步开始使用您配置的设置。这样可保留广泛的开局选择，同时在之后去掉部分低概率走法。恢复对局或从某局面继续时，也按该局面的回合数执行。

在1.0 / 1.0时无需此选项：这些设置已在全局保留完整多样性，因此开关显示为关闭且不可选。
Korean (provisional):
기본으로 켜져 있습니다. 양쪽의 처음 다섯 수에는 온도와 Top-P 1.0 / 1.0을 사용하고, 여섯 번째 수부터 설정값을 사용합니다. 오프닝 선택은 넓게 유지하고 이후에는 낮은 확률의 수를 걸러낼 수 있습니다. 저장 대국을 재개하거나 특정 위치에서 이어 두어도 해당 위치의 수 번호를 따릅니다.

1.0 / 1.0에서는 이미 대국 내내 모든 후보를 유지하므로 스위치가 꺼진 채 비활성화됩니다.

Mantiene opciones amplias en la apertura y permite descartar jugadas poco probables después. Respeta el número de jugada de la posición, también al reanudar o continuar una partida.

No hace falta con 1,0 / 1,0: el interruptor queda apagado y no se puede activar porque esos ajustes ya ofrecen toda la variedad durante la partida.
German (provisional):
Standardmäßig an. Nutzt Temperatur und Top-P 1,0 / 1,0 für die ersten fünf Züge beider Seiten, danach deine Einstellungen. So bleibt die Eröffnungsauswahl breit, während später unwahrscheinliche Züge entfallen können. Maßgeblich ist die Zugnummer der Stellung, auch beim Fortsetzen einer Partie.

Bei 1,0 / 1,0 ist dies unnötig: Der Schalter ist aus und nicht wählbar, da diese Werte bereits durchgehend volle Vielfalt bieten.
French (provisional):

Russian (provisional):
Включено по умолчанию. На первых пяти ходах каждой стороны используются температура и Top-P 1,0 / 1,0, с шестого — ваши настройки. Korean (provisional): Maia가 수를 선택할 때 이전 포지션을 최대 7개까지 활용하도록 합니다. 79M 모델을 사용한 저희 테스트에서는 사람의 수를 예측하는 정확도가 약 2%포인트 높아졌지만, 낮은 레이팅의 오프닝에서 상대의 수를 반복해서 따라 하기도 했습니다. 현재는 꺼 두는 것을 권장합니다.
Spanish (provisional): Permite que Maia use hasta siete posiciones anteriores al elegir una jugada. En nuestras pruebas con el modelo 79M, esto mejoró la precisión al predecir jugadas humanas en unos 2 puntos porcentuales, pero a veces llevó a imitar repetidamente jugadas en aperturas de jugadores con menor Elo. Por ahora, recomendamos dejarlo desactivado.
German (provisional): Lass Maia bei der Zugwahl bis zu sieben vorherige Stellungen nutzen. Save Maia’s move probabilities, settings and selected moves on this device to explore how it plays.

Exported files contain board positions, move history and model inputs and decisions.

The last 10 recorded games are saved and presented newest first. Older games may be removed sooner if the storage limit is reached. This is separate from Recent Games.

Use this feature if you are interested in studying the technical details of how Maia works. Data cannot be viewed in the app. It is exported to an easy-to-view HTML file containing a subset of the data, or a JSONL file containing all the recorded data.

This is off by default, and we recommend keeping it off unless you are interested in researching how Maia works.

Screen / context: Engine help: Temperature section and opening probability examples. Legacy message ID retained; English revised 2026-10-25. All supported languages translate this approved English explanation. Maia-specific, not a Lichess equivalent.
English source:
Temperature

At Temperature 0, Maia always plays the move it predicts a player at the selected Elo is most likely to play. This is technically called argmax.

At Temperature 1, Maia considers the full range of moves it predicts a player at the selected Elo might play, choosing among them according to their probabilities.

At a Temperature between 0 and 1, Maia puts more weight on the moves it considers most likely. Lower Temperature values make Maia's choices more predictable.

For example, in our tests with the 79M model at rating inputs of 1600 for both players, Maia’s opening probabilities as White were approximately:

• 1. e4: 64%
• 1. d4: 25%
• 1. c4: 3%
• All other moves combined: 8%

At Temperature 0, Maia always played 1. e4

At Temperature 0.5, it played 1. e4 about 86% of the time and 1. d4 about 13% of the time. Other moves remained possible, but together accounted for less than 1%.

At Temperature 1, Maia followed the original probabilities listed above.

温度が0と1の間の場合、Maiaはより指されやすいと判断した手を重視します。温度を下げるほど、Maiaの選ぶ手は予測しやすくなります。

例えば、79Mモデルを使い、両プレイヤーのレーティング入力を1600にした私たちのテストでは、Maiaが白番で最初に指す手の確率はおよそ次のとおりでした。

• 1. e4：64%
• 1. d4：25%
• 1. c4：3%
• その他の手の合計：8%

温度0では、Maiaは必ず1. e4を指しました。

温度0.5では、1. e4を約86%、1. d4を約13%の割合で指しました。その他の手も選ばれる可能性はありましたが、合計で1%未満でした。

温度1では、Maiaは上記の元の確率に従って指しました。

तापमान 0 और 1 के बीच होने पर Maia उन चालों को ज़्यादा वज़न देता है जिन्हें वह सबसे अधिक संभावित मानता है। तापमान जितना कम होगा, Maia के चुनाव का अनुमान लगाना उतना ही आसान होगा।

उदाहरण के लिए, 79M मॉडल के साथ हमारे परीक्षणों में, जब दोनों खिलाड़ियों की रेटिंग इनपुट 1600 थी, तो सफ़ेद मोहरों से Maia की पहली चाल की संभावनाएँ लगभग ये थीं:

• 1. e4: 64%
• 1. d4: 25%
• 1. c4: 3%
• बाकी सभी चालें मिलाकर: 8%

तापमान 0 पर Maia ने हमेशा 1. e4 खेला।

तापमान 0.5 पर उसने लगभग 86% बार 1. e4 और लगभग 13% बार 1. d4 खेला। बाकी चालें भी संभव थीं, लेकिन कुल मिलाकर उनका हिस्सा 1% से कम था।

तापमान 1 पर Maia ने ऊपर दी गई मूल संभावनाओं के अनुसार चालें चुनीं।
Brazilian Portuguese (provisional):
Temperatura

Com temperatura 0, o Maia sempre joga o lance que prevê ser o mais provável para um jogador com o Elo selecionado. Isso é chamado tecnicamente de argmax.

Com temperatura 1, o Maia considera todos os lances que prevê que um jogador com o Elo selecionado poderia jogar, escolhendo entre eles de acordo com suas probabilidades.

Com uma temperatura entre 0 e 1, o Maia dá mais peso aos lances que considera mais prováveis. Quanto menor a temperatura, mais previsíveis ficam suas escolhas.

Por exemplo, nos nossos testes com o modelo 79M e entradas de rating de 1600 para ambos os jogadores, as probabilidades do primeiro lance do Maia com as brancas foram aproximadamente:

• 1. e4: 64%
• 1. d4: 25%
• 1. c4: 3%
• Todos os outros lances juntos: 8%

Com temperatura 0, o Maia sempre jogou 1. e4.

Com temperatura 0,5, jogou 1. e4 em cerca de 86% das vezes e 1. d4 em cerca de 13%. Outros lances continuaram possíveis, mas juntos representaram menos de 1%.

Com temperatura 1, o Maia seguiu as probabilidades originais listadas acima.

Screen / context: Engine help: Top-P section and filtering example. Legacy message ID retained; English revised 2026-10-25. All supported languages translate this approved English explanation. Maia-specific, not a Lichess equivalent.
English source:
Top-P

Top-P filters the available moves after Temperature adjusts their probabilities.

At Top-P 1, no filtering is applied. All available moves can be played according to their temperature-adjusted probabilities.

At Top-P 0.95, Maia keeps the most likely moves whose combined probability reaches at least 95%, then chooses among them. The excluded moves account for at most 5% of the probability.

At Top-P 0, Maia always chooses the most likely move. This has the same effect as Temperature 0: either setting is sufficient to produce argmax.

In our opening example, Temperature 1 and Top-P 0.60 would make Maia always play 1. e4. That move alone accounts for about 64% of the probability, so no other moves are needed to reach the 60% threshold.

Top-P

Top-P 0.95では、確率の高い順に、合計確率が95%以上に達するまでの手を残し、その中から選びます。除かれる手の合計確率は最大5%です。

Top-P 0では、Maiaは必ず最も確率の高い手を選びます。これは温度0と同じ効果です。どちらか一方を0にするだけでargmaxになります。

先ほどの初手の例では、温度1、Top-P 0.60にすると、Maiaは必ず1. e4を指します。この手だけで確率の約64%を占めるため、60%のしきい値に達するのに他の手は必要ありません。

Top-P为0.95时，Maia按概率从高到低保留走法，直到累计概率达到至少95%，然后从中选择。被排除走法的累计概率最多为5%。

在前面的开局示例中，温度为1、Top-P为0.60时，Maia总是会走1. e4。仅这一步就占约64%的概率，因此无需其他走法便能达到60%的阈值。

Top-P

앞의 오프닝 예에서 온도 1, Top-P 0.60으로 설정하면 Maia는 항상 1. e4를 둡니다. 이 수 하나만으로 확률의 약 64%를 차지하므로, 60% 기준에 도달하는 데 다른 수가 필요하지 않습니다.

German (provisional):
Top-P

Top-P filtert die verfügbaren Züge, nachdem die Temperatur ihre Wahrscheinlichkeiten angepasst hat.

Bei Top-P 0,95 behält Maia die wahrscheinlichsten Züge, bis ihre gemeinsame Wahrscheinlichkeit mindestens 95 % erreicht, und wählt dann unter ihnen aus. Die ausgeschlossenen Züge machen höchstens 5 % der Wahrscheinlichkeit aus.

Bei Top-P 0 wählt Maia immer den wahrscheinlichsten Zug. Das hat dieselbe Wirkung wie Temperatur 0: Es reicht, einen der beiden Werte auf 0 zu setzen, um argmax zu erhalten.

In unserem Eröffnungsbeispiel würde Maia mit Temperatur 1 und Top-P 0,60 immer 1. e4 spielen. Dieser Zug allein macht etwa 64 % der Wahrscheinlichkeit aus. Um die Schwelle von 60 % zu erreichen, sind also keine weiteren Züge nötig.

Screen / context: Engine help: Effect on play, analogy and direct-match research. Legacy message ID retained; English revised 2026-10-25. All supported languages translate this approved English explanation. Maia-specific, not a Lichess equivalent.
English source:
How do these settings affect Maia’s play?

You can think of Top-P as an angel on Maia’s shoulder. At 0, the angel tells Maia to ignore lower-probability moves, which can include blunders or unsound moves. At 1.0, the angel has gone, and Maia could select even the craziest, most improbable move.

In our direct-match tests at the 1600 setting, argmax outperformed Temperature 1.0 / Top-P 1.0 by the equivalent of about 300 Elo points. However, argmax also limited opening choices to a narrow range of mainly main lines.

レーティング設定1600での直接対戦テストでは、argmaxは温度1.0 / Top-P 1.0を約300 Elo相当上回る成績を収めました。ただし、オープニングの選択肢も、主にメインラインの狭い範囲に限られるようになりました。

在等级分设置为1600的直接对局测试中，argmax的表现优于温度1.0 / Top-P 1.0，相当于约300个Elo等级分的差距。不过，argmax也把开局选择限制在以主线为主的较小范围内。

English source:
We recommend keeping max opening variety on and Temperature set to 1.0 and Top-P set to 0.95. This is like having a creative player with an angel on its shoulder that at least talks it out of playing the totally far-out moves—the least likely moves whose combined probability is up to 5%. These might be brilliant, true, but they can also be silly blunders. So this should make for a good balance of variety in the opening, creativity in the middle game, and stronger play through the exclusion of some very low-probability blunders.

For those feeling brave, Temperature 0 produced the strongest play in our tests. Good luck!

Screen / context: User-approved Maia win (score) percentage setting/help, 2026-10-26. The model estimates expected game points including half-point draws. Preserve the 60 points in 100 games example, independent rating inputs and human/Stockfish comparison. Maia-specific, not a direct Lichess equivalent.
English source: For example, White 60% means Maia estimates White would score about 60 points across 100 games from this position. A win earns 1 point; a draw earns ½.
Japanese (provisional): 例えば「白 60%」は、この局面から100局指した場合に、白が合計約60点を獲得するとMaiaが見積もっていることを意味します。勝ちは1点、引き分けは½点です。
Simplified Chinese (provisional): 例如，“白方 60%”表示 Maia 估计，从此局面开始下100盘棋，白方大约能得到60分。获胜得1分，和棋得½分。
Korean (provisional): 예를 들어 “백 60%”는 이 포지션에서 100판을 두면 백이 약 60점을 얻을 것으로 Maia가 추정한다는 뜻입니다. 승리는 1점, 무승부는 ½점입니다.
Spanish (provisional): Por ejemplo, Blancas 60% significa que Maia estima que las blancas conseguirían unos 60 puntos en 100 partidas desde esta posición. Una victoria vale 1 punto; unas tablas, ½.
German (provisional): Zum Beispiel bedeutet Weiß 60%, dass Maia für Weiß etwa 60 Punkte aus 100 Partien ab dieser Stellung erwartet. Ein Sieg bringt 1 Punkt, ein Remis ½ Punkt.
French (provisional): Par exemple, Blancs 60% signifie que Maia estime que les Blancs marqueraient environ 60 points sur 100 parties à partir de cette position. Une victoire rapporte 1 point ; une nulle, ½ point.
Russian (provisional): Например, «Белые 60%» означает, что, по оценке Maia, белые набрали бы около 60 очков в 100 партиях из этой позиции. Победа приносит 1 очко, ничья — ½ очка.
Hindi (provisional): उदाहरण के लिए, सफेद 60% का मतलब है कि Maia के अनुमान में इस स्थिति से शुरू होने वाली 100 बाज़ियों में सफेद लगभग 60 अंक पाएगा। जीत पर 1 अंक और ड्रॉ पर ½ अंक मिलता है।
Brazilian Portuguese (provisional): Por exemplo, Brancas 60% significa que a Maia estima que as brancas fariam cerca de 60 pontos em 100 partidas a partir desta posição. Uma vitória vale 1 ponto; um empate, ½.

Screen / context: User-approved Maia win (score) percentage setting/help, 2026-10-26. The model estimates expected game points including half-point draws. Preserve the 60 points in 100 games example, independent rating inputs and human/Stockfish comparison. Maia-specific, not a direct Lichess equivalent.
English source: The estimate uses the selected Maia analysis rating for both players. With two Maias enabled, each shows its own estimate at its own rating.

Simplified Chinese (provisional): 该估计将所选的 Maia 分析等级分应用于双方。启用两个 Maia 时，每个 Maia 都会按各自的等级分显示自己的估计。
Korean (provisional): 추정치는 선택한 Maia 분석 레이팅을 양쪽 선수에 적용합니다. Maia 두 개를 활성화하면 각각 자신의 레이팅에 따른 추정치를 표시합니다.
Spanish (provisional): La estimación supone que ambos jugadores tienen el Elo de análisis seleccionado para Maia. Si activas dos Maias, cada una calcula su estimación con su propio Elo.
German (provisional): Die Einschätzung verwendet die gewählte Maia-Analysewertung für beide Spieler. Sind zwei Maias aktiviert, zeigt jede ihre eigene Einschätzung mit ihrer jeweiligen Wertung.
French (provisional): L’estimation utilise le classement d’analyse Maia sélectionné pour les deux joueurs. Si deux Maias sont activées, chacune affiche sa propre estimation à son propre classement.
Russian (provisional): Оценка использует выбранный рейтинг анализа Maia для обоих игроков. Если включены две Maia, каждая показывает свою оценку при своём рейтинге.
Hindi (provisional): यह अनुमान दोनों खिलाड़ियों के लिए चुनी हुई Maia विश्लेषण रेटिंग का उपयोग करता है। दो Maia चालू होने पर, हर Maia अपनी रेटिंग के अनुसार अपना अनुमान दिखाती है।
Brazilian Portuguese (provisional): A estimativa usa a classificação de análise selecionada para a Maia nos dois jogadores. Com duas Maias ativadas, cada uma mostra sua própria estimativa na sua própria classificação.
